description: Returns the full body of the evaluation request for a corridor, an amount and the route you would use anyway (baseline_provider): you fill only your sender, recipient and gas ceilings, then sign it with recta_prepare_signed_request and recta_send_signed_request.

amount.description: How much of source_asset to send, in whole tokens (not cents, not wei): "100" with USDC means 100 USDC. Minimum 3.5 for stablecoins (about 3.5 USD). No maximum.

baseline_provider.description: The route you would use without Recta (see recta_fit_check's declarable_baselines).

source_network.description: Lowercase network as in the service descriptor, e.g. base, ethereum, arbitrum.

name: recta_request_template
title: The whole evaluation request for my transfer (free, no signature)
